opportunities.name: NPS find park by state and open park info
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, choose a state in the Find a Park dropdown, then open a specific park or heritage area link from that state's page (e.g. Basic Information or Current Conditions).
steps: Click the 'By State...' dropdown under Find a Park
On the state page, find the target park or area
Click the wanted link (Basic Information / Current Conditions / National Heritage Areas, etc.)

instances.values: state=Alaska; National Heritage Areas -> Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm NHA

opportunities.name: Resy book special event tickets
opportunities.description: On Resy, open Special Events & Experiences for a city, pick an event, set the number of tickets, choose a ticket option or time slot, and continue to Complete Your Reservation.
steps: Open resy.com and select the city
Open Special Events & Experiences (Events collection or 'See More')
Set the ticket count in the Tickets dropdown
Click the ticket tier's Book Now button or the time slot
Review the Complete Your Reservation dialog and confirm
